item.title: Guest Lecturer at "Real-World Robot Learning", University of Pennsylvania"
item.description: In 2025 I gave a guest lecture “Learning from Internet Data” for the course “Real-World Robot Learning” at The University of Pennsylvania taught by Prof. Antonio Loquercio and Prof. Dinesh Jayaraman.

item.title: Lecturer for "Vision Algorithms for Mobile Robotics"
item.description:
Between 2019-2022 I gave the deep learning lectures at the “Vision Algorithms for Mobile Robotics” taught by Prof. Davide Scaramuzza at the University of Zurich and ETH Zurich.

Additionally, I acted as a TA for the course in 2019 and 2020.
